name: playwright-skill
tagline_zh: 打工人的外挂：playwright-skill。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Complete browser automation with Playwright. Auto-detects dev servers, writes reusable test scripts, and supports screenshots, responsive checks, UX validation, login flows, link checks, and arbitrary browser automation. Use when the user wants to test a website, automate browser interactions, validate web functionality, or perform browser-based testing.
